title: NBI completes DNA tests for 90% of Yolanda victims in Tacloban

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY – The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) has completed DNA analysis for 90 percent of the more than 2,200 victims of Super Typhoon Yolanda in this city, 13 years after the disaster, the agency said Wednesday. NBI Eastern Visayas Regional Director Jeremy Lotoc said the DNA results will be turned over to Mayor Alfred Romualdez for distribution to the victims’ surviving families ahead of the 13th anniversary of the disaster on Nov. 8, 2026. A team of medico-legal and forensic experts from the NBI central office returned to Metro Manila on Oct. 27, signaling the completion of the latest […]...
